command:
set -u -o pipefail -C
destination=$(dirname "$(dirname "$TMPDIR")")
manifest() {
  /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import json,runpy; p=runpy.run_path("remediation-runs/2026-09-08-continuation/controls/run_continuation_controls.py",run_name="control_input_observation"); print(json.dumps(p["manifest"](),indent=2))'
}
manifest > "$destination/l08-control-inputs-before.json" || exit 2
single=0
/usr/bin/python3 -B remediation-runs/2026-09-08-continuation/controls/test_single_tap_fixture_review.py > "$destination/single-tap-recheck.log" 2>&1 || single=$?
functional=0
/usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s remediation-runs/2026-09-07-local-readiness/l08-storage-functional-companion-02 -p test_l08_functional_copy.py -v > "$destination/functional-copy-recheck.log" 2>&1 || functional=$?
printf '{"single_tap_exit_code":%s,"functional_copy_exit_code":%s}\n' "$single" "$functional" > "$destination/l08-command-exits.json" || exit 2
manifest > "$destination/l08-control-inputs-after.json" || exit 2
cmp "$destination/l08-control-inputs-before.json" "$destination/l08-control-inputs-after.json" || exit 2
printf '{"single_tap_exit_code":%s,"functional_copy_exit_code":%s,"control_inputs_unchanged":true,"scope":"Focused control recheck, not application/runtime proof"}\n' "$single" "$functional" > "$destination/l08-control-recheck-results.json" || exit 2
test "$single" -eq 0 && test "$functional" -eq 0
